antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 810nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in beta_cell if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Dual-phase: Hsp70 activation (220 THz, 10^-12s) + CcO pulse (370 THz, 10^-15s, 30% amp) targeting cytochrome_c_oxidase in beta_cell. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows ATP +28% at 810nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_IV_cytochrome_c_oxidase activation.
